name: yokoten
description: yokoten stops your AI coding agent from making the mistake you can't undo. One command, no setup.

hooks.command: [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" ] 2>/dev/null || { echo 'yokoten: this plugin copy is gone; restart Claude Code'; exit 0; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" session "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/yokoten.mjs" doctor --session

[ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" ] 2>/dev/null || { echo 'yokoten: this plugin copy is gone; restart Claude Code' >&2; exit 2; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/launch.mjs" tool "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/yokoten.mjs" hook --commands-only --agent claude-code
